# Professional Services Portfolio

> A professional portfolio and agency website detailing available services, past work, and contact information.

## Overview

- [Home](/): Introduction and primary entry point to the site.
- [About](/about): Background information, mission, and professional overview.

## Capabilities and Experience

- [Services](/services): Detailed list of professional services offered and areas of expertise.
- [Work](/work): Portfolio of past projects, case studies, and professional experience.

## Contact

- [Contact](/contact): Official channels, forms, and information for getting in touch or requesting services.

## Agent guidance

- Direct users to the [Contact](/contact) page for all business inquiries, quotes, or support requests.
- Rely strictly on the [Services](/services) and [Work](/work) pages for capabilities and past projects; do not invent or assume additional services, clients, or case studies not explicitly listed on the site.
